fields.label: Preset
fields.description: The ready-made look of the public website.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.description: Shown in the header. Empty: the app name of Website Settings.

fields.label: Contact e-mail
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer. The contact form sends its messages to this address (Contact Us Settings). An address at foss.ua is refused.

fields.label: Contact phone
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page and in the footer, one line per row.

fields.label: Data controller name
fields.description: The full name of the person or company that is responsible for the data collected on the site. It is written on the Privacy page; until you enter it the page shows a placeholder.

fields.label: Contact form
fields.description: The form is shown only when the guard app (frappe_guard) is installed and has reCAPTCHA v3 keys for this site's address. Enter the keys of your own domain here (register it at google.com/recaptcha); on a site address that ends in erp-crm.org the keys of the platform are used while these fields are empty. Without keys the Contact page shows your e-mail and phone instead of the form.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA site key
fields.description: The public key of reCAPTCHA v3 for your domain.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA secret key
fields.description: The secret key of the same pair. It is stored encrypted and never shown.

fields.label: Allow search engines
fields.description: Off: the site sends X-Robots-Tag noindex and robots.txt disallows everything.

fields.label: Token overrides
fields.description: JSON with the values that differ from the preset: {"tokens": {"color-primary": "#1d4ed8"}, "variants": {"card": "raised"}}.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: Not applied yet: the validated Custom CSS editor comes in a later release.

fields.label: Notes on the standard pages
fields.description: Written when a new kit version could not replace a page or component that you edited.

fields.label: Standard pages state
fields.description: What the kit last wrote into each standard page, component and script. Used to tell your edits from the kit's version.
